visual.name: atlynResourceCapacity
visual.description: Read-only resource-period capacity exception analysis with explicit units and partial-data disclosure.

en-US.Title: Atlyn Resource Capacity
en-US.MultiSelect: Toggle multi-select for touch or pointer
en-US.Summary: {0} overloaded | {1} missing or invalid | {2} delivered records
en-US.OnboardingFields: 1. Bind Resource, Period, Allocated amount and Available capacity.
en-US.OnboardingUnit: 2. Set one compatible unit in Analysis contract, such as hours or FTE.
en-US.OnboardingGrain: 3. Supply one model-authoritative value per resource-period. Totals stay off unless both amounts are additive.
en-US.AmbiguousLabels: Different model keys have identical formatted labels. Inspect cell details or make the model format more specific.
en-US.SelectForDetails: Focus a cell to inspect its model values. Next ! moves without selecting.
en-US.NoIdentityCell: This cell has no native identity and cannot filter the report.
en-US.UnitHelp: Required. Both measures must use this same unit. No conversions or availability assumptions are made.
en-US.TotalsHelp: Enable only when both amounts are additive across non-overlapping periods. FTE, rates and snapshots usually are not.
en-US.Rejected: Host refused more data. Analysis remains partial; narrow report filters.
en-US.Waiting: Still waiting for the host. Narrow report filters or refresh the report if loading does not finish.
en-US.InteractionError: Host interaction failed. Try again or refresh the report.
en-US.InteractionsDisabled: Report filtering interactions are disabled by this host.
en-US.RenderError: The visual could not render this data. Check field bindings and refresh.
en-US.bind: Bind one stable Resource, one Period, Allocated amount and Available capacity. Use only the optional measures shown in the field wells.
en-US.shape: Inconsistent category/measure lengths or a source format longer than 512 characters. No analysis is shown; check the model or refresh.
en-US.keys: Resource and Period must be nonblank, finite keys of at most 512 characters. Dates must be valid dates; do not bind a date hierarchy.
en-US.KeyDiagnostic: Input diagnostic: visual {0}; row {1}; role {2}; type {3}; expected {4}.
en-US.order: Period order is missing, nonfinite, inconsistent for a label, or shared by different labels. Supply one unique order per label.
en-US.UnitRequired: Set Analysis contract > Compatible unit (for example hours or FTE). Both measures must use the same unit.
en-US.Empty: No resource-period data in this report context.
en-US.Partial: PARTIAL data: not all resource-period records are available. Totals are suppressed.
en-US.Reduced: Host reports data reduction. Completeness cannot be established.
en-US.Bounds: Bound reached: 200 resources, 104 periods, 10,000 cells/source records maximum. Narrow report filters.
en-US.Scope: {0} resources x {1} periods; {2} loaded records. Scope: host-delivered report context, not the entire model.
en-US.Problems: {0} invalid cells; {1} duplicate intersections. Duplicates are not summed.
en-US.NoIdentity: Some cells lack native identities; those cells cannot filter related visuals.
en-US.TotalsUnavailable: Totals unavailable for incomplete, missing or invalid periods, nonadditive metadata, or numeric overflow.
en-US.Legend: + spare | = full | ! overload | N nonworking | / unavailable | ? missing | X invalid | D duplicate | H highlighted
en-US.Help: Arrow keys move; Home/End move within a row; Ctrl+Home/End move to grid corners; Page Up/Down move by a viewport. Enter/Space select; Ctrl/Meta/Shift or the + toggle adds selections. Alt+ArrowDown moves to the next overload without selecting. Escape closes details, then clears selection; Shift+F10 or a touch long-press opens the host menu. Headers stay pinned while scrolling. No automatic rebucketing.
en-US.MissingRecord: No delivered record (missing or not yet loaded)
en-US.HighlightHelp: H shows host-highlighted values; the heat state still uses full supplied amounts.
en-US.invalidValue: Amounts must be finite, nonnegative numbers or blank. No invalid amounts are treated as zero.
en-US.overflow: Numeric range exceeded. No ratio or total is displayed.
en-US.ZeroCapacity: Positive allocation against zero capacity is overload; utilization is undefined.

fr-FR.Title: Atlyn Resource Capacity
fr-FR.ReadOnly: Analyse de capacite en lecture seule
fr-FR.MultiSelect: Activer la selection multiple tactile ou au pointeur
fr-FR.Summary: {0} surcharges | {1} absents ou invalides | {2} enregistrements livres
fr-FR.Onboarding: Comparer la charge avec la capacite disponible
fr-FR.OnboardingFields: 1. Lier Ressource, Periode, Quantite allouee et Capacite disponible.
fr-FR.OnboardingUnit: 2. Definir une unite compatible dans Contrat d'analyse, par exemple heures ou ETP.
fr-FR.OnboardingGrain: 3. Fournir une valeur de modele par ressource-periode. Totaux desactives sauf si les deux quantites sont additives.
fr-FR.AmbiguousLabels: Des cles distinctes ont le meme libelle formate. Inspecter les details ou preciser le format du modele.
fr-FR.SelectForDetails: Focaliser une cellule pour inspecter ses valeurs. Suite ! se deplace sans selection.
fr-FR.NoIdentityCell: Cette cellule sans identite native ne peut pas filtrer le rapport.
fr-FR.UnitHelp: Obligatoire. Les deux mesures doivent utiliser la meme unite. Aucune conversion ni hypothese de disponibilite.
fr-FR.TotalsHelp: Activer uniquement pour deux quantites additives sur des periodes sans chevauchement. ETP, taux et instantanes ne le sont generalement pas.
fr-FR.Rejected: Chargement refuse par l'hote. Analyse partielle ; reduisez les filtres du rapport.
fr-FR.Waiting: En attente de l'hote. Reduisez les filtres ou actualisez le rapport si le chargement ne se termine pas.
fr-FR.InteractionError: Interaction avec l'hote echouee. Reessayez ou actualisez le rapport.
fr-FR.InteractionsDisabled: Les interactions de filtrage sont desactivees par cet hote.
fr-FR.RenderError: Impossible d'afficher ces donnees. Verifiez les champs et actualisez.
fr-FR.bind: Liez une Ressource stable, une Periode, la Quantite allouee et la Capacite disponible. Utilisez uniquement les mesures facultatives indiquees.
fr-FR.shape: Longueurs de categories/mesures incoherentes ou format de plus de 512 caracteres. Aucune analyse ; verifiez le modele ou actualisez.
fr-FR.keys: Ressource et Periode doivent etre des cles finies non vides de 512 caracteres maximum. Utilisez une date valide, pas une hierarchie.
fr-FR.KeyDiagnostic: Diagnostic d'entree : visuel {0} ; ligne {1} ; role {2} ; type {3} ; attendu {4}.
fr-FR.order: Ordre de periode absent, non fini, incoherent ou partage par plusieurs libelles. Fournissez un ordre unique par libelle.
fr-FR.UnitRequired: Definissez Contrat d'analyse > Unite compatible (heures ou ETP). Les deux mesures doivent avoir la meme unite.
fr-FR.Empty: Aucune donnee ressource-periode dans ce contexte.
fr-FR.Partial: Donnees PARTIELLES : certains enregistrements manquent. Totaux masques.
fr-FR.Reduced: L'hote signale une reduction des donnees. Exhaustivite non etablie.
fr-FR.Bounds: Limite atteinte : 200 ressources, 104 periodes, 10 000 cellules/enregistrements maximum. Reduisez les filtres.
fr-FR.Scope: {0} ressources x {1} periodes ; {2} enregistrements charges. Portee : contexte livre par l'hote, pas le modele entier.
fr-FR.Problems: {0} cellules invalides ; {1} intersections en double. Les doublons ne sont pas additionnes.
fr-FR.NoIdentity: Certaines cellules sans identite native ne peuvent pas filtrer les autres visuels.
fr-FR.TotalsUnavailable: Totaux indisponibles : periodes incompletes, absentes ou invalides, mesures non additives ou depassement numerique.
fr-FR.Legend: + libre | = plein | ! surcharge | N non travaille | / indisponible | ? absent | X invalide | D doublon | H surbrillance
fr-FR.Help: Fleches : deplacement ; Debut/Fin : ligne ; Ctrl+Debut/Fin : coins ; Page haut/bas : ecran. Entree/Espace : selection ; Ctrl/Meta/Maj ou bouton + : selection multiple. Alt+FlecheBas : prochaine surcharge sans selection. Echap : fermer les details puis effacer ; Maj+F10 ou appui tactile long : menu hote. En-tetes fixes. Aucun regroupement automatique.
fr-FR.MissingRecord: Aucun enregistrement livre (absent ou non charge)
fr-FR.SuppliedNonworking: Non travaille fourni par le modele
fr-FR.HighlightHelp: H indique les valeurs en surbrillance de l'hote ; l'etat utilise les quantites completes.
fr-FR.invalidValue: Les quantites doivent etre finies, positives ou nulles, ou vides. Une valeur invalide n'est jamais remplacee par zero.
fr-FR.invalidNonworking: Non travaille doit etre 0, 1 ou vide.
fr-FR.overflow: Plage numerique depassee. Aucun taux ni total affiche.
fr-FR.ZeroCapacity: Une allocation positive avec capacite nulle est une surcharge ; utilisation non definie.
